<!-- pr-reviewer: 1a6d4017ea6cfa836c7b349d86c2c9a9ac8260d2 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (high-tier review: holder bodies feed the collision judgement). One note: the author's comment says to merge it together with #1061 (the #1037 workholding gap), #1043 first.

**What looks good**
- Placement is one undoable command both ways: the tool editor's Apply body queues `CommandKind::SetLatheToolBody` -> `SetToolBody::lathe` (`crates/ui/src/state_tool_body_lathe.rs` `run_set_lathe_tool_body`), and the five MCP tools in `crates/app/src/mcp/body_tools.rs` each build a `SetToolBody` and `history.execute` it. Invert restores `prev`; undo/redo is pinned by `mcp_tool_body` and `vendor_tool_body`.
- Validation is at command creation: `SetToolBody::lathe`/`insert_zone` check tool kind, square directions, tip distance and zone size by name before the command exists; the UI shows the refusal on the Tool pane and keeps the draft. MCP argument shapes are checked (`vec3`, `zone_arg`).
- No stale clear verdict: the lathe body's clearance bands are in the operation stamp (`tool_body::digest`), so a body set/changed/undone makes the op Stale and posting refuses it until regenerated. `vendor_tool_body` regenerates after each change and shows the rub (3.2 mm, post blocked) and its mirror clear.
- The single `tool_body_file` door now refuses a reduced-fidelity STEP (#864) for every body path (from_file, from_step_auto, lathe_from_file, load_aligned, MCP), by name, instead of silently judging a too-small holder. Good safety call.
- Layering holds (ui -> app commands only, no components outside schema), provenance lines present, no unwrap/expect/panic or unchecked casts in new non-test code, new files all under ~230 lines, decisions file in `docs/decisions/`, no snapshot PNG or CHANGELOG edits, fixture is original.
- Process: camcraft-mcp skill updated and `PROCESS_VERSION` 16 -> 17.

**Local results** (trial merge with upstream/main a6bd69d8, clean, no conflicts; own worktree/target)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds |
| vendor_tool_body | 3 passed |
| mcp_tool_body | 5 passed |
| tool_body | 12 passed |
| turning_holder | 8 passed |
| tool_csys | 11 passed |
| turning_insert_zone | 5 passed |
| holder_library | 11 passed |
| tool_body_judged | 8 passed |
| tool_body_bands | 13 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (crates/ui) | 537 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The tool-editor lathe section (radial/spindle presets and face picks, tip pick, insert-zone fields, boring-bar frame switch, layout at the editor's size) needs the maintainer's hand check; the picks are tested only through state calls, and the author did not click the 3D preview.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is 17 here and 16 on upstream/main now; the author notes coordinating with #930/#1024. Re-check the number at merge and post the #681 announcement.
- Merge order: #1043, then #1061 (stacked; retarget #1061 to main first). Until #1061 lands, a lathe body is judged against part and stock only (#1037).
- Inch-document lathe fields were not exercised by a test (author noted).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
